name: kelp
description: Kelp — self-serve security agent for vibe-coded apps (Supabase/Lovable/Bolt/Replit).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm -w @kelp/web run dev" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.test: tsc -b packages/core && node --test packages/core/dist/*.test.js packages/core/dist/scanners/*.test.js packages/core/dist/remediation/*.test.js packages/core/dist/agent/*.test.js packages/core/dist/agent/specialists/*.test.js
